title: [HIGH] Order lookup has no ownership check (CWE-639)
description:
**File:** `src/api/orders.ts` (lines 12, 13)
**Project:** openaudit
**Severity:** HIGH  •  **Confidence:** high  •  **Slug:** `idor`

## Finding

GET /orders/:id loads any order by id without comparing it to the session user. CWE-639. Key seen: sk_live_abcdefghijklmnop1234.

## Recommendation

Constrain the query by the authenticated user id.

revalidation.reasoning: Handler reads req.params.id and never checks req.user.
